climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Central Coast valley in San Luis Obispo County with cool maritime fog, moderate sunshine, and volcanic, clay-rich soils with black humus. Those conditions give it California's longest growing season. It lies nine miles southeast of San Luis Obispo.
